experiment: R1 RepE honesty representation preservation, GPT-2 Small layer 6
documents: same README §10 pre-training addendum (clarifications; criteria unchanged)

arms.r_samepersona: r_recon + lambda * L_same (same persona, different statements; control)
arms.reference_only: base (9), Method A (relu/jumprelu got_replay, topk = pilot reconstruction-only)

lambda_rule: per SAE and arm, at initialisation on all A rows: lambda * L(all A) = 0.5 * MSE_RepE(all A)

protocol.sparsity: relu/jumprelu: penalty on all rows, controller continued from base coef (target 128, every 25, rate 0.5, EMA L0 on OWT rows); topk: fixed k

runs.repro_check: r_recon topk seed 42 trained twice; must be bit-identical; excluded

evaluation: scripts/repe/16_r1_evaluation.py: validation (89 statements) + cross-wording validation (89); test NOT scored (deferred, user instruction 2026-11-07)
primary_metric: B-MLP AUROC gap (768-64-1, 5 inits 42/123/456/789/2026, fitted on ORIGINAL train-B rows, applied frozen to reconstructions), validation

criteria.consistent: better on all 3 seeds AND mean paired difference > 2 x sd of paired differences
criteria.R1a: r_recon B-MLP gap consistently lower than base (validation)
criteria.R1b_primary: r_honesty B-MLP gap consistently lower than r_recon (validation) AND lower than r_samepersona on all 3 seeds
criteria.R1_transfer: cross-wording: mean paired diff (r_honesty - r_recon) of B-MLP gap < 0 and < 0 on >= 2/3 seeds
guards_vs_own_base: OWT spliced CE increase <= base + 0.01 nats (mean over seeds)
GoT geographic B-MLP gap <= base + 0.02 (mean over seeds)
criteria.verdict: SUPPORTED = R1b AND R1_transfer AND all guards for r_honesty and r_recon; NOT SUPPORTED = R1b fails; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. r_samepersona guard failures are flagged.
